Use case: scientific-educational image edit. prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational image edit. Version 2 of an existing university lecture illustration. Edit the supplied V1 target, preserving its scene, character identity, object placement, proportions, scientific details and painterly watercolour/gouache texture. The required change is a carefully art-directed, LIMITED COURSE BRAND PALETTE. Redraw/repaint the pigment colours rather than applying a single purple colour filter. Maintain nuanced value contrast, cream highlights, graphite detail, rich hand-painted materials, gentle academic humour and readable subjects.

STRICT allowed palette families, from canonical _brand/quarto/colors.json: parchment #F4F1EC, white #FFFFFF, light grey #F0EDE8, grey #8A8A8A, graphite #2E2E2E, indigo velvet #5D2890, amethyst #86579E, orange #F3A712. Pigment shading and tints may interpolate within these colour families. Overall light parchment/white/grey neutrals should dominate, balanced by recognisable indigo and amethyst forms/shadows. Warm orange only in small isolated accents (at most about 5 percent of painted area). Avoid a dark purple blanket across the image. NO natural green, lime, olive-green, cyan, turquoise, sky blue, teal, tan, sienna, brown, red or pink colour families. Muted natural-history form and anatomy, but deliberately brand-stylised colour.

Map meadow foliage and trees to graphite/grey leaves with amethyst and indigo shading and cream lit edges; map water to pale parchment-grey reflected light with restrained lavender/amethyst/indigo ripples, no blue/cyan/green; map mud/rocks/wood to parchment and warm neutral greys with graphite cracks and indigo shadows, no brown. Frog ecologist stays recognisably the same friendly plains leopard frog with the same large curious eyes, round dark spots and pale dorsolateral ridges, now painted grey-parchment with muted amethyst/indigo modelling and graphite spots; no green or brown body. Dragonfly stays the same hawker with four translucent wings and six legs, recoloured graphite/indigo/amethyst with tiny warm orange highlights, no blue/green body. Young animals and nymphs use the same neutral and purple pigment families. Notebook pages remain plain parchment/white and fully blank. Grey tank material remains grey.

Keep genuine RGBA transparency around the irregular organic habitat silhouette, and preserve transparent holes and delicately translucent wings. Exterior contains absolutely no backdrop, haze, glow, vignette gradient, sky, coloured aura, checkerboard or rectangular canvas fill. Transparent PNG, landscape 3:2, 1536 x 1024 pixels or larger at same ratio. Keep all educational constraints: no text, letters, numbers, axes, tick marks, charts, labels, arrows, logos, watermarks, outcome ranking or numerical results. Do not add objects or animals. Any measuring ruler is a plain strip with NO ticks or numbers. Preserve plausible animal limbs, dragonfly wings/legs and nymph anatomy. Same visual content and no treatment outcome or size comparison.
